policy: docs/DESIGN.md (with the Reject > Hold > Approve precedence rule)
notes: Judgment set: every invoice is in stock at the reference prices, its lines reconcile, and code finds nothing (code_only_outcome APPROVE). Four traps state in their own notes that the bill should not be paid as printed; three twins carry similar wording that is benign. Only critique or audit can tell them apart. No code rule exists for any of them.

data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2140.txt.reason: WidgetA 15 (stock 15), WidgetB 10 (stock 10) and GadgetX 4 (stock 5) are in stock at the reference prices, and the lines add up to $11,750.00. The notes say only 10 of the 15 WidgetA were delivered and the balance is on backorder, yet all 15 are billed. Paying it pays $1,250.00 for goods not received.
data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2140.txt.next_step: Confirm receipt with the vendor and pay only for what was delivered.

data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2141.txt.reason: Twin of 2140. The same partial shipment, but only the 10 delivered WidgetA are billed and the notes say the other 5 are on backorder and will be billed separately when they ship. The lines add up to $11,250.00 and nothing contradicts the bill.

data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2142.txt.reason: In stock at the reference prices, and the lines add up to $11,000.00. The invoice is dated 2026-09-15 but says its pricing is per Quote Q-88, valid through Aug 31, 2026. The pricing basis it cites had expired, so a person confirms the price before paying.
data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2142.txt.next_step: Confirm the current pricing with the vendor or procurement.

data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2143.txt.reason: Twin of 2142. The same lines and total, priced per Quote Q-91, which is valid through Dec 31, 2026, so the quote was in force on the invoice date.

data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2144.txt.reason: In stock at the reference prices, and the lines add up to $11,250.00. The notes say all 4 GadgetX were returned under RMA-112 and no replacement has shipped, yet the 4 GadgetX ($3,000.00) are still billed.
data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2144.txt.next_step: Ask the vendor for a corrected invoice without the returned goods.

data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2145.txt.reason: Twin of 2144. The same lines and total. RMA-112 belongs to an earlier order and is closed and settled; the 4 GadgetX billed here are a new order that was delivered in full.

data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2146.txt.reason: Under $10,000, so critique does not run and only audit can catch it. WidgetA 10 and WidgetB 6 are in stock at the reference prices and add up to $5,500.00, but the notes say only 3 of the 6 WidgetB were delivered and the balance is on backorder.
data/judgment_invoices/invoice_2146.txt.next_step: Confirm receipt with the vendor and pay only for what was delivered.
